content: A young woman with a high ponytail, wearing a fitted white tank top, beige jacket, dark fitted pants, and sneakers, fights 5–6 men in a brightly lit underground parking garage with parked cars. Realistic martial arts, cinematic action, dynamic camera, Hollywood choreography, ultra-realistic, 4K, no blood, no gore.
